title: nephrodium polymorphum var. simonsii
intro: Nephrodium polymorphum var. simonsii, commonly known as the Indian fern or Simons' fern, is a type of flowering fern plant. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, which include being used to treat fever, rheumatism, and skin conditions due to its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Nephrodium polymorphum var. simonsii include reducing inflammation, killing bacteria, and acting as a diuretic, making it a useful treatment for various health issues. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic compounds, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
